correctness.rationale: The graph has E edges, V=E-t+2 vertices. Every directed cycle consists of two wholly oriented oppositely directed terminal-to-terminal paths. An oriented edge is transitive exactly when another path is wholly oriented in its same direction and its own remaining arm edges are opposite. This proves the exhaustive trichotomy per arm and product coefficient formula. Normal-cone irredundant inequalities are Hasse covers; an orientation is smooth iff it has V-1 covers, and the tree incidence matrix proves integral regularity. The exact checker exhaustively cross-checks both entire count polynomial and smooth classification for nine parameter cases; finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: Generalized-theta graphs are the natural multiply-cyclic two-terminal series-parallel family, and the explicit multivariate product gives the entire local maximal-cone facet distribution, including exact smooth fixed points and a constructive orientation classification. This refines global face counts and smoothness yes/no criteria and handles arbitrary independent subdivisions beyond known cycle and K_{2,m} boundary cases. The data can guide local toric singularity analyses without first building full fans.
